name: Greater Planar Rift

source.title: Pathfinder #162: Ruins of the Radiant Siege

disable: Dispel Magic (9th rank; counteract DC 46) to seal the rift

items.name: Greater Planar Rift
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves within 5 feet of the rift

---

Effect The creature must succeed at a DC 44 Will save save or be drawn into the rift. A creature so drawn in becomes Stunned 3 and immediately teleports to a different random area in Kharnas's ruins.

text: A ragged planar rift drags things into its depths and hurls creatures through from its terminal end.
